old_caption: The video features an elderly man with a long white beard and glasses, dressed in a formal gray suit over a crisp white shirt. He is holding a white mug in his right hand and appears to be engaged in a conversation or presentation. The setting is minimalistic, with a plain dark background that emphasizes the subject. The overall atmosphere is professional and focused, with the robot adding a futuristic element to the scene.

caption: A white-bearded man in a grey suit and round glasses holds a white mug by its handle in his right hand, the cup already at chest level. To the left, a silver-and-black robotic arm with a two-finger gripper and a small camera-like head sits motionless against a grey backdrop. The man raises the mug, its rim climbing from his chest toward his face while his eyes track the cup downward. As the rim meets his lips near the middle of the clip, he tilts the mug upward into a sipping posture and holds it there. His gaze drifts forward, peering over the rim rather than down at the cup. The framing tightens, the man growing larger on the right and the robot arm sliding toward the lower-left corner, indicating a slow camera push-in rather than arm movement. The drinking motion continues as the clip ends, the mug at his mouth.
